name: Dark Aure Inspired by Nuit de Feu | Intense Smoky Arabic Unisex Perfume
description: Dark Aure, inspired by the luxurious Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu, is an intense, smoky, and deeply captivating unisex Arabic fragrance. It opens with the rich aroma of Somalian incense, delivering a bold and mystical first impression. As it evolves, a strong heart of pure agarwood (oud) and refined leather emerges, creating a powerful and elegant Middle Eastern character. The scent finishes with warm birch tar and woody nuances, giving the fragrance its signature smoky, resinous, and long-lasting depth. Crafted with a high perfume-oil concentration, Dark Aure offers exceptional longevity and projection—making it perfect for winter nights, special gatherings, and lovers of strong Arabic oud scents. Bold, mysterious, and unforgettable, this fragrance brings the premium Nuit de Feu experience at an accessible price, exclusively from Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Incense (Somalian Olibanum) Heart Notes: Oud, Leather Base Notes: Birch Tar, Woody Notes Longevity: 12+ hours (Extremely Long-Lasting) Occasion: Best for nights, winter, gatherings, and Arabic events Why Choose Dark Auré? story: Dark Aure, inspired by Nuit de Feu, blends rich incense, oud, leather, and birch tar to create a deep, smoky, and long-lasting Arabic unisex fragrance perfect for night wear.
